arguments.sql:
WITH sales AS (
    SELECT product_code,
           COUNT(*) AS sale_rows,
           MIN(date) AS first_date,
           MAX(date) AS last_date,
           COUNT(sold_quantity) AS populated_quantities,
           SUM(sold_quantity) AS total_quantity
    FROM main.hardware_fact_sales_monthly
    WHERE date >= '2021-01-01' AND date < '2022-01-01'
    GROUP BY product_code
),
catalog AS (
    SELECT division, COUNT(*) AS catalog_rows,
           COUNT(DISTINCT product_code) AS catalog_codes,
           COUNT(DISTINCT product) AS catalog_product_names,
           COUNT(product) AS populated_product_names
    FROM main.hardware_dim_product
    GROUP BY division
),
matched AS (
    SELECT p.division, COUNT(*) AS matched_codes,
           COUNT(DISTINCT p.product) AS matched_product_names,
           SUM(s.sale_rows) AS matched_sale_rows,
           SUM(s.populated_quantities) AS populated_quantities
    FROM sales AS s
    JOIN main.hardware_dim_product AS p ON p.product_code = s.product_code
    GROUP BY p.division
)
SELECT c.*, m.matched_codes, m.matched_product_names, m.matched_sale_rows,
       m.populated_quantities,
       (SELECT SUM(sale_rows) FROM sales) AS total_sale_rows,
       (SELECT MIN(first_date) FROM sales) AS first_sale_date,
       (SELECT MAX(last_date) FROM sales) AS last_sale_date
FROM catalog AS c
LEFT JOIN matched AS m ON c.division IS m.division
ORDER BY c.division

WITH product_totals AS (
    SELECT p.division, p.product, SUM(s.sold_quantity) AS total_quantity_sold
    FROM main.hardware_fact_sales_monthly AS s
    JOIN main.hardware_dim_product AS p ON p.product_code = s.product_code
    WHERE s.date >= '2021-01-01' AND s.date < '2022-01-01'
    GROUP BY p.division, p.product
),
ranked_products AS (
    SELECT division, product, total_quantity_sold,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
               PARTITION BY division
               ORDER BY total_quantity_sold DESC, product
           ) AS division_rank
    FROM product_totals
)
SELECT division, product, total_quantity_sold, division_rank
FROM ranked_products
WHERE division_rank <= 4
ORDER BY division, division_rank
